QIXARC reference typography

These WOFF2 files were supplied publicly by QIXARC's Scaler Profile website
and reused at the owner's request on 2026-10-04.

Source: https://scalerprofile.vercel.app/

- display.woff2: /_next/static/media/71db9fb9a9a8cba1.p.woff2 (display, weight 400)
- sans.woff2: /_next/static/media/5977941da3f6f441-s.p.woff2 (sans, weight 400)
- mono.woff2: /_next/static/media/db9d659a1acad1e2-s.p.woff2 (mono, weight 400)

The page switch follows the reference's vertical curtain, slowed to 800 ms per direction using
cubic-bezier(.76, 0, .24, 1), with a destination label and QIXARC cyan rule.
